body.title: Implement computeContentIdentity
body.summary: computeContentIdentity(repoPath, targets) returns a deterministic digest over the repo's HEAD commit sha plus a sha256 of every file named in targets.entries' actual, current raw bytes -- a simple, shared, non-manager-aware hash (the same function s3 will also call over the same targets).
acceptanceChecks: editing an application-source file listed in targets.entries changes the digest
editing a file NOT in targets.entries leaves the digest unchanged
two calls with no intervening change to targets.entries' files yield the identical string
a targets.entries path resolving outside repoPath throws
repoPath that is not a registered git repository, or whose HEAD cannot be resolved, throws

tests.name: computeContentIdentity: an application-source file in targets.entries is edited, manifests/lockfiles unchanged -> digest changes
computeContentIdentity: a file NOT in targets.entries is edited -> no change
computeContentIdentity: identical targets.entries bytes -> identical string on repeated calls
computeContentIdentity: a targets.entries path outside repoPath throws
